label: Measure code
definition: Unique, persistent code of the measure. The same measure keeps the same code in later updates of the programme, so that its progress can be followed. Primary key.

label: Measure name
definition: The original descriptive name of the measure, or an English translation of it.

label: Measure name language
definition: Language of `measureName`, as a code from the ISO 639-2 vocabulary.

label: Measure reference
definition: Place in a document that describes the measure, where there is one.

label: Measure type
definition: Type or types of the measure, by the article of the Directive they implement. Select one or more, as in the draft format. All the types of a measure concern the same kind of object: treatment plants, or agglomerations.

label: Other measure description
definition: Description of another appropriate measure under Article 18(2).

label: Geographical coverage
definition: Whether the measure applies to the whole Member State or to the plants or agglomerations listed in `euUWWTPCode` or `euAgglomerationCode`.

label: Treatment plants
definition: Codes of the treatment plants the measure concerns, as in the spatial points dataflow. Several codes are separated by commas. The identifier scheme is always `euUWWTPCode`.
condition: Required if `geographicalCoverage` = `listedObjects` and the measure types concern treatment plants; empty otherwise. Accepted codes in {ref}`sp-uwwtp`

label: Agglomerations
definition: Codes of the agglomerations the measure concerns, as in the spatial points dataflow. For a measure at treatment plants, the agglomerations those plants serve. Several codes are separated by commas. The identifier scheme is always `euAgglomerationCode`.
condition: Required if `geographicalCoverage` = `listedObjects`, for every measure type; empty otherwise. Accepted codes in {ref}`sp-agglomeration`

label: Prioritisation
definition: Priority of the measure, related to the size of the agglomeration and the level of environmental impact.

label: Implementation status
definition: Whether the measure is planned, ongoing, executed or cancelled. In the first programme most measures are planned or ongoing.

label: Implementation period
definition: Range of years from the year in which the works start, or are expected to start, to the year in which the measure is expected to be completed, both included, for example `[2028,2033]`. For a measure at a treatment plant, the completion year is the year of expected compliance, meaning 12 months of compliant samples. Where the start year is not known, the lower bound is left open: `[,2036]`.

label: Cost status
definition: Whether the capital expenditure of the measure is known or estimated. Applies to the expenditure of all its rows in {ref}`art23-measurefinancing`.

label: Remarks
definition: Any relevant comment on the measure.
